summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K with Exhibit 1.1, a routine Total Voting Rights announcement dated 01 October 2026 under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules (DGTR 5.6), the US equivalent of a Form 8-K disclosure of share capital. As at 30 September 2026, issued ordinary share capital comprised 15,705,666,807 shares (US$0.25 par), plus 12,706,252 preference shares; 780,646,187 ordinary shares sit in treasury. Total voting rights are 15,710,749,307. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or closing date is stated; shareholders use the figure for DGTR interest notifications. No deal terms to watch.
